# DNS.usectl.com — Full Technical Reference
> Source: https://dns.usectl.com | Parent: https://usectl.com

## 1. Overview
DNS.usectl.com replaces bloated, ad-ridden legacy DNS checkers (e.g. whatsmydns) with an instant, ad-free edge propagation radar.

## 2. API & Resolver Endpoints
| Resolver | Region | Location | Protocol | Format |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Cloudflare | Anycast | 300+ PoPs | DoH | JSON (RFC 8427) |
| Google Public DNS | Anycast | Global | DoH | Google JSON |
| Quad9 | Anycast | Zurich HQ | DoH | JSON (RFC 8427) |
| OpenDNS | North America | San Jose, CA | DoH | JSON (RFC 8427) |
| Control D | North America | Ashburn, VA | DoH | JSON (RFC 8427) |
| CIRA Canadian Shield | North America | Toronto, CA | DoH | JSON (RFC 8427) |
| DNS.SB | Europe | Frankfurt, DE | DoH | JSON (RFC 8427) |
| DNS0.EU | Europe | Paris, FR | DoH | JSON (RFC 8427) |
| AdGuard | Europe | Amsterdam, NL | DoH | JSON (RFC 8427) |
| Mullvad | Europe | Stockholm, SE | DoH | JSON (RFC 8427) |
| AliDNS | Asia | Hangzhou, CN | DoH | Google JSON |
| DNS.SB | Asia | Singapore, SG | DoH | JSON (RFC 8427) |
| Control D | Asia | Tokyo, JP | DoH | JSON (RFC 8427) |
| Control D | Oceania | Sydney, AU | DoH | JSON (RFC 8427) |
| Control D | Latin America | São Paulo, BR | DoH | JSON (RFC 8427) |
| Control D | Africa | Johannesburg, ZA | DoH | JSON (RFC 8427) |

## 3. SSL/TLS Inspection Endpoint
Endpoint: `/api/ssl?domain={domain}`
Returns:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "domain": "usectl.com",
  "valid": true,
  "daysRemaining": 78,
  "expiresAt": "2026-11-20 12:00 UTC",
  "issuer": "Let's Encrypt",
  "tlsVersion": "TLSv1.3",
  "cipher": "TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384",
  "sans": ["usectl.com", "*.usectl.com"]
}
```

## 4. CLI Usage Examples
```bash
# Query A record via Cloudflare
dig +short A usectl.com @1.1.1.1

# Query TXT records via Google
dig +short TXT usectl.com @8.8.8.8

# DoH JSON query
curl -s -H 'accept: application/dns-json' 'https://cloudflare-dns.com/dns-query?name=usectl.com&type=A'
```
